life_event: Born in St. Francisville, Louisiana Punished severely and frequently by stepfather (beaten); domineering mother 3 to 13 never intervened. Challenged developmentally; put in special education classes. Was taunted by classmates for being "retarded," got into frequent trouble. Sucked thumb in class; called his teacher "momma." Began peeping into windows during elementary school. Learned early in life that he could talk his way out of trouble; never took responsibility for his misbehavior. Tortured his dog and its puppies. Experienced many injuries; no evidence of head injuries.
Arrested for burglary and vandalizing candy store. Attacked woman in front of his mother for accusing him of peeping.
Arrested for 2nd-degree murder, was released. Set own car on fire for insurance money. Arrested for attempted burglary, but charges were reduced to unauthorized

Married Jaqueline Sims in Solitude, LA Found it difficult to keep a job. 2/17/1989 Began harassing mother for his childhood problems with stepfather. Pleaded guilty to misdemeanor trespassing and sentenced to therapy; he never 4/13/1989 showed up. Wife called police when Derrick slapped her around; threatened her father with 5/23/1989 a gun. Charged with disturbing the peace, but served no jail time. 10/29/1989 Arrested for disturbing the peace after fistfight at Price's Bar in St. Francisville.
Bludgeoned Connie Warner to death with a hammer in Zachary, LA 9/2/1992 Connie Warner's body was found in vacant lot in Baton Rouge.

Arrested for burglary and resisting arrest in Zachary, LA. 1/1/1993 Committed robbery and assault while awaiting trial. 4/3/1993 Attacked teenage couple with 6 ft. harvesting tool while they are parked. 5/11/1993 Sentenced to four years in prison for previous burglary; serves two.

Released from prison. 7/7-10/1995 Moved family to Lake Charles, LA 9/6/1995 Arrested for peeping. 9/24/1995 Arrested for robbing Salvation Army clothes drop-off. 09/26- 30/1995 Moved family back to St. Francisville.
Father-in-law died in plant explosion; Jackie receives $250,000 settlement. 9/1/1996 Wife purchased .25 handgun.

Arrested for DWI after failing a sobriety test. 2/19/1997 Earned CDL. Stopped by Zachary police for suspicion of peeping, but not charged, even 2/19/1997 after a positive witness ID. Judge rescinded state order to suspend Lee's drivers license after state failed to 3/1/1997 respond to motion of discovery. 5/1/1997 Hired by Louisiana Readi-Mix as a truck driver. 6/1/1997 Eugenie Boisfontaine murdered in Baton Rouge. Nearly ran over coworker’s car with semi truck, and was demoted to driving 7/25/1997 cement trucks. Arrested in Zachary for 6 counts of peeping tom, criminal trespass, and 7/31/1997 burglary. 10/30/1997 Disciplined for substandard work

Enrolled in Diesel Driving Academy in Baton Rouge, LA Pleaded guilty to six counts of peeping tom; sentenced to two years probation 1/14/1998 and psychological testing. Jan-Feb 1998 Attended two therapy sessions with Dr. Robert Snyder, a psychologist. Is called a "good verbal therapy participant" by Dr. Snyder in a letter to the 2/1/1998 court. 3/1/1998 Michelle Chapman identified Lee in photo lineup for cemetery attack. Fired from Louisiana Ready-Mix for insubordination and for causing two 4/16/1998 accidents in one week. 4/18/1998 Raped, beat, and stabbed Randi MeBruer to death in Zachary, LA. West Feliciana Sheriff's deputies interrogated Lee in the MeBruer 4/19/1998 investigation, and confiscated a pair of pants at his home. Leroy Shorts told James Odom that Derrick Lee Killed Randi Mebruer; Odom 4/20/1998 reported it to the police. 4/1/1998 The police began paying Shorts to inform on Lee.

Began relationship with Consandra Green. 6/1/1999 Lee put under surveillance in MeBruer investigation. 6/1/1999 Began stalking Collette Walker. 6/14/1999 Pushed into Walker's apartment and attempted to persuade her into a date. Walker's neighbor, Diane Halloway, filed a complaint against Derrick, which 8/16/1999 was not pursued by police. 8/19/1999 Lee was caught by Walker's son while peeping into apartment. 8/19/1999 A warrant was issued for Lee's arrest for stalking and unlawful entry. 8/20/1999 Lee was arrested for stalking and unlawful entry.

Lee was bailed out of jail. Plead guilty to the charges and was sentenced to 6 months in jail (received 12/17/1999 credit for time served) and two years probation. 12/17/1999 Cosandra Green called police to report Lee was threatening to kill her. 1/19/2000 Green inquired about protective order from court. Lee beat Green in parking lot of Liz's Lounge and was arrested by West 1/22/2000 Feliciana Parish Sheriff's deputies. Green refused to testify, and Lee was sentenced to one year in jail.

Lee was released from jail. 3/1/2001 Hired for temporary position at Dow Chemical Plant in Brusly, LA Mar-Apr-01 Began looking for Collette Walker again. 4/1/2001 Bought Hyundai Accent with wife, and reunited with Green. 9/26/2001 Arrested for simple battery on wife. 9/27/2001 Stopped showing up for work at Doe. Battery charges dropped

Began working at Dow again. 1/11/2002 Laid off from Dow. 1/14/2002 Beat and stabbed Geralyn DeSoto to death in Baton Rouge. 4/1/2002 Worked for two weeks at JE Merit. 5/1/2002 Filed for and received unemployment. 6/1/2002 Started job at ExxonMobil plant in Baton Rouge. Beat, strangled, and attempted to rape Diane Alexander in Saint Martin parish; 7/9/2002 she survived. Saint Martin parish police released a composite sketch and description of Lee's 7/15/2002 car in an attempt to find Alexander's attacker. Collette Walker called task force to provide Lee's name and background as a 9/4/2002 suspect. Nov. 2002 34 Signed a car loan for one of his girlfriends. 11/18/2002 Filed an insurance claim on Cosandra Green's Dodge Neon. 11/21/2002 Raped and beat to death Dene Colomb with a tree branch in Lafayette, LA.. 12/25/2002 Mary Ann Fowler disappeared in Port Allen, LA. 2/1/2003 Started working the night shift at ExxonMobil. 3/3/2003 Killed Carrie Lynn Yoder in Baton Rouge, LA. Left work at the end of February and returned on March 6th to pick up his 3/1/2003 check. Met a woman at a shopping mall and drove her home. He returned several times to masturbate while he watched her (with her permission), and to 3/1/2003 masturbate in his truck outside her house when she was not home. 4/1/2003 Laid off from ExxonMobile. Multi-agency task force announced for the first time that serial killer could be a 3/21/2003 black man. 5/5/2003 Zachary police collected DNA from Lee in the MeBruer case. 5/5/2003 Lee left the state by Greyhound. 5/7/2003 Lee returned home to move his possessions. 5/9/2003 Lee said goodbye to his family. 5/10/2003 The Lee family moved to Detroit to live with relatives. Diane Alexander's attack was linked by DNA to the serial killer, giving 5/14/2003 investigators a description of his appearance and automobile. 5/25/2003 Lee's DNA was matched to the serial killings. As Cosandra Green's home was being searched Lee called her on the phone; 5/26/2003 the caller ID located him in Atlanta. 5/26/2003 A tip led police to Lee's location in Atlanta and he was arrested.

Trial for the murder of Geralyn DeSoto began. 8/6/2004 Lee complained to judge about his public defender. DeSoto's estranged husband detailed his discovery of the crime scene in testimony. Prosecution rested after Lee's son identified boots linked to DeSoto crime 8/9/2004 scene. 8/10/2004 Jury found Lee guilty of second degree murder after two hours of deliberation. Conviction carried a mandatory life sentence. 9/13/2004 Trial for the murder of Charlotte Murray Pace began. 9/29/2004 Main jurors selected for Pace trial. First day of proceedings in Pace trial; jury was shown over 100 pictures of the 10/4/2004 crime scene. 10/5/2004 DNA analysis linking Lee to the murder scene was presented. 10/11/2004 Lee identified by Diane Alexander in testimony. Lee found guilty and recommended for the death penalty after 93 minutes of 10/12/2004 deliberation. 10/14/2004 Lee's sister took stand to testify for defense in sentencing hearing. Defense argued against death penalty, reiterating Lee's limited mental capacity.

Lee formally sentenced to death. Decision was made to not prosecute Lee in Colomb case because of family 1/11/2005 concerns. Diane Alexander requested dismissal of her case against Lee for personal 2/11/2005 reasons. Attorney Thompson pursued new trial in West Baton Rouge due to lack of oath 4/28/2005 of office on file for prosecutor Tony Clayton. 5/24/2005 Appeal formally accepted by Judge Richard Anderson. 5/28/2005 West Baton Rouge Parish denied new trial request. Court record for Pace murder was given to Louisiana Supreme Court for 8/4/2005 mandatory review.

Diane Alexander sued Crime Stoppers for $150,000 5/24/2006 Deal was made to destroy DNA samples taken from suspects in search for Lee. 6/2/2006 Federal Judge approved of the destruction of DNA. Defense attorneys handling appeal attempted to obtain seven pages from 9/29/2006 original trial transcript.
